title: Lena recruiting coordinator scratchpad - 2026-03-12
content:
Daily scratchpad — 2026-03-12 (updated 2026-03-13)

Top priorities:
- Confirm onsite schedule for Diego Alvarez (eng loop) — need travel packet by Thu 
- Follow up with Priya Nair re: compensation band question (sent email 3/11)
- Fix double-booking on Harper's calendar (conflict 11:30–12:00)

Morning quick hits:
- 09:00 — triage inbox: 4 candidate reschedule requests, 2 recruiter check-ins
- 09:30 — move Jordan Miles interview to Zoom (candidate requested Google Meet -> prefers Zoom)
- 10:00 — send interview prep sheet to Emily Zhao (panel + take-home info)

Candidate follow-ups (action list):
1) Jordan Miles — SOFTWARE ENGINEER (US-PST)
   - Status: scheduled, 2026-03-15 10:00 PST (confirm time zone)
   - Action: swap to Zoom and update calendar; cc Marcus Rivera.
   - Draft note: "Thanks Jordan — switching to Zoom. Updated invite attached. Let me know if you need a different time." (sent?)

2) Priya Nair — SENIOR PM (APAC)
   - Status: waiting (comp band question)
   - Action: short note w/ band ranges + ask if they want recruiter call. If no reply by EOD Fri escalate to Sofia.
   - Timezone note: candidate in IST (UTC+5:30) — avoid 22:00 local.

3) Diego Alvarez — INFRA ENGINEER (on-site)
   - Status: tentative onsite 2026-03-22
   - Action: confirm travel packet, visa docs checklist, hotel reimbursement link. Confirm dietary restrictions.
   - Interviewers: Harper Lee (HM), Marcus Rivera (Eng lead), Tanya (SRE)

4) Emily Zhao — RESEARCH ASSOCIATE (time-sensitive take-home)
   - Status: take-home deadline extended to 3/18 per candidate request
   - Action: send reminder 3 days before due date; note: uses Python v3.10

5) Omar Haddad — DIVERSITY HIRE (intro screen)
   - Status: no-show 3/10 — left voicemail
   - Action: try SMS follow-up today 3/13; if no response, archive candidate in ATS after 2 tries.

Calendar housekeeping:
- Harper: 11:30–12:00 conflict with recurring 1:1. Find 30 min slot after 2pm to shift.
- Rooms: Reserve Conf B for Diego onsite loop 3/22 (full day)
- Buffer windows: please keep 15m before/after loops for prep/debrief (update interview template)

Interview logistics checklist (for onsite + hybrid):
- Visitor badge form (HR ops) — make sure submitted 1 week prior
- Parking instructions + building access code — include in confirmation email
- Laptop loaner request? Ask hiring manager if need any equipment
- Accessibility needs — flag for facilities if requested

Email snippets to copy/paste:
- Reschedule reply (short): "Hi [Name], thanks for the heads up — I can move you to [NEW TIME]. Please confirm and I’ll send an updated invite. Best, Lena"
- No-show follow-up: "We missed you for the interview today. If you’d like to reschedule, reply with 3 times that work this week."
- Take-home reminder: "Friendly reminder: your take-home for [role] is due [date]. Reach out if you need an extension."

Notes to self / process reminders:
- When toggling time zones, always set calendar to candidate's zone first then host's. Avoid manual math.
- ATS tags: put "no-show" with notes, reference call attempt timestamps
- Update interview packet template with new parking URL (ops changed vendor last month)
- Keep canned messages in Google Keep (so I don't rewrite)

Immediate TODO (today):
- [ ] Zoom switch for Jordan — 09:45
- [ ] SMS Omar — 10:15
- [ ] Email Priya compensation ranges — 11:00
- [ ] Block travel days for Diego in Harper's calendar — 14:00
- [ ] Reserve Conf B for 3/22 — 15:00

Follow-ups this week (debriefs & offers):
- Schedule debrief for ENG loop (3/16 morning preference) — invite: Marcus, Harper, Tanya, me
- Draft offer for strong candidate (pending comp signoff) — flagged to finance (JIRA-REC-742)

Edge cases / uncommon notes:
- Candidate with multiple last names — double-check passport name for background check (Diego A. sometimes uses second last name)
- Candidate in military reserve — need to confirm potential leave dates before offering start date

Quick hacks/shortcuts I use:
- Copy Zoom link to all invites, then replace with Zoom link in original invite rather than creating new one — keeps thread intact
- Use "find busy times" in calendar when proposing 3 options to panel

Slack reminders to send:
- "@Marcus please confirm 3/16 debrief time" (short)
- "@Harper can you confirm travel approval for Diego? Need by Fri"

Open questions / things to check later:
- Do we have updated parental leave start date language for offer letters? (HR asked last month)
- Confirm reimbursement cap for candidate travel — updated policy doc link?

End-of-day ritual:
- mark tasks done in ATS, close notes on candidates I contacted
- quick 5-min tidy of this doc — move done items to archived.txt

Random scratch:
- Thought: could we add 30-min "float" slot on Harper's calendar each Wed for candidate catch-ups? would reduce conflicts.

— Lena
